title: Best Niagara Falls Tour with Boat, Lunch & Journey Behind Falls
includes: Skylon Tower ride to the top observation
Voyage to the Falls Boat Cruise - Hornblower
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: If you are driving, the tour provider can assign you a pickup location where parking is available
You will have approximately 45-minutes for lunch
You will have approximately an hour of free time
Note: The Niagara City Boat Cruise is only available April through November as it is closed during winter months because of ice
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Pickup from Niagara Falls, Ontario. A professional, local licensed tour guide will lead this sightseeing tour. Discover the Canadian side of Niagara Falls on this 4-hour tour with commentary by a knowledgeable guide. Walk behind the falls with Journey Behind the Falls, where the mighty Horseshoe Falls tumbles from 13-stories high and crashes below, Souvenir City, Whirlpool Rapids, and Floral Clock. Enjoy a Niagara City Cruise & journey behind the falls. Scenic drive along Niagara River

Note: The Niagara City Boat Cruise is only available April 15 through November 30 as it is closed during winter months due to ice.
